extraction_warnings.message: Only one annual-report document was user supplied. The FY2025 annual report contains three-year comparative financial statements, but intake's historical_annuals document-count recommendation (3) is not met.
No separate earnings-release/8-K document was user supplied for Stage 0; official Q3 FY2026 guidance is handled outside the FP pack as supplemental valuation evidence.
Geographic revenue is based primarily on shipment/delivery location and should not be interpreted as ultimate end-customer demand by country.
End-customer concentration is disclosed for the top five customers in aggregate; customer identities and individual shares are not disclosed.

AI XPV exposes Broadcom to a maximum $29B lease backstop and the customer may under certain conditions issue up to $42B of convertible promissory notes to Broadcom; the filing states no notes were issued as of 2026-08-02, so the $42B capacity is not treated as a current liability or included in a calculated off-balance total.
